subject: deleting current element in selectizeInput box causes severe error

messages.author: 41029975cde3e6ed
messages.subject: deleting current element in selectizeInput box causes severe error
parts:
The gQTLbrowse function defined in github repo vjcitn/gQTLbrowser can be run with
example(gQTLbrowse) -- it involves R-devel and latest version of bioconductor.

If I alter the selectInput command to selectizeInput, it starts up fine but when I delete
the default selection to start a selectize operation, the processing code tries to handle the
blank input present upon deletion and throws an error.

Is there some way to defer processing until the item has really been identified/selected?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: deleting current element in selectizeInput box causes severe error
parts: > Is there some way to defer processing until the item has really been identified/selected?

This is what validate/need was designed for (pass FALSE as the message). It means that the outputs that rely on this input will go blank though.

If you really don't want that, you can use a reactiveValues and observer; instead of referring directly to the input, refer to a reactiveValues value, and set up an observer to only update the reactiveValues using the input IF the input is non-empty. (However, I think this would look kind of confusing in the UI if you deleted the selected value and nothing actually changed.)
